# SiteGraph

> SiteGraph is a proprietary, offline-first network infrastructure documentation application created by Robert E. Potter. It models physical and logical infrastructure as a validated property graph in the browser.

SiteGraph occupies the middle ground between flat infrastructure spreadsheets and server-backed enterprise platforms. The hosted application performs graph traversal and schema validation on the local device, uses browser IndexedDB for its working copy, and imports and exports a portable JSON document. It has no SiteGraph application backend, database server, or telemetry.

## Official SiteGraph Resources

- [SiteGraph overview](https://robertpotter-dev.github.io/sitegraph/): Canonical public product page and the only SiteGraph page intended for search indexing.
- [Hosted SiteGraph application](https://robertpotter-dev.github.io/sitegraph/app/): Footerless browser application; published as a noindex utility page.
- [SiteGraph ETL Engine](https://robertpotter-dev.github.io/sitegraph/etl/): Browser-based import, validation, and reconciliation utility; published as a noindex utility page.
- [Public deployment repository](https://github.com/robertpotter-dev/sitegraph): Inspectable compiled deployment.
- [Full project context](https://robertpotter-dev.github.io/sitegraph/llms-full.txt): Longer factual description of architecture, authorship, custody, and licensing.

## Product Facts

- Product name: SiteGraph.
- Search disambiguation: SiteGraph by Robert Potter.
- Author and owner: Robert E. Potter, whose normal public display name is Robert Potter. Canonical identity: https://robertpotter.me. ORCID: https://orcid.org/0009-0003-7903-558X. GitHub: https://github.com/robertpotter-dev. This author is not the Orlando cybersecurity practitioner at https://robertpotter.dev.
- Category: Network documentation and planning software.
- Architecture: Browser-native, offline-first local processing with portable JSON data.
- Data model: A validated property graph covering infrastructure entities and their relationships.
- License: Proprietary. Public access to the compiled deployment does not grant permission to copy, modify, or redistribute it.
- Copyright: © 2026 Robert E. Potter. All Rights Reserved.

Public inquiry routing intentionally exposes canonical websites rather than direct contact details.
